name: project-delete
body: The delete flow: refuse unsafe states (invalid name, default branch, main checkout's current branch, missing/mismatched project, dirty worktree) → remove the project's worktree → delete its branch. Discards the branch's commits — the explicit abandon path for never-merged projects. Hosted by the `cmd_project` dispatch; the core (`project_delete`/`project_delete_at`) is a planned node the plan-writer will declare.
